business_problem: Guangdong Power Grid needed to modernize customer-service operations with better intent understanding and a self-improving knowledge base because legacy customer-center knowledge was outdated, hard to search, and unable to support agents handling complex power-service questions efficiently.
solution_summary: Guangdong Power Grid worked with Baidu AI Cloud to build an intelligent dialogue and knowledge-service stack centered on a private-deployment natural-language-processing solution. The system uses intent recognition, entity recognition, multi-turn dialogue, semantic understanding, and knowledge-graph methods to interpret customer requests and extract the key information needed for service responses. On top of that dialogue layer, the project created a domain-specific intelligent knowledge base for the utility's customer center. Machine-learning models identify reusable enterprise language assets and continuously mine historical interactions between users and service robots so the knowledge base can evolve instead of remaining static.
products_used: Private Deployment Natural Language Processing Solution

solution_components.name: Private Deployment Natural Language Processing Solution
solution_components.role: Provides the utility's core language-understanding stack for customer-service dialogue.

solution_components.name: Intent Recognition
solution_components.role: Identifies the purpose of customer questions so the service can route and answer them accurately.

solution_components.name: Multi-turn Dialogue
solution_components.role: Manages service conversations across multiple exchanges in the intelligent dialogue system.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Graph
solution_components.role: Supports the evolving customer-service knowledge base and improves answer grounding.

data_flow: Customer questions enter the dialogue system, where NLP models identify intent, entities, and semantic meaning. The system retrieves guidance from the power-service knowledge base, returns the answer to the customer, and feeds historical robot conversations back into machine-learning workflows so the knowledge base can keep improving.
business_outcome: Guangdong Power Grid improved how its service channels understand customer needs, created a self-improving utility knowledge base, and laid a foundation for broader intelligent customer service and power-industry consultation.
architecture_clues: The deployment combines intent recognition, entity recognition, semantic understanding, and multi-turn dialogue in one customer-service stack
The utility created a domain-specific intelligent knowledge base for its customer center
Historical conversations with the service robot are mined continuously so the knowledge base can self-improve
